name: Dragonborn
summary: Dragonborn are draconic humanoids with ancestry-selected breath weapons and matching damage resistance; later versions add flexible ability scores and distinct chromatic, metallic, and gem variants.

languages: Fizban variants: Common plus one agreed language
resistances: ancestry-selected: acid, lightning, fire, poison, or cold; gem variants add force, radiant, psychic, thunder, or necrotic
damage_immunities: Chromatic Warding grants temporary immunity to ancestry damage type at 5th level for Fizban chromatic dragonborn

features.name: Draconic Ancestry
features.description: Choose a dragon ancestry; it determines breath weapon damage type/area and associated resistance.

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.description: Exhale destructive energy in an ancestry-defined area. PHB version uses an action, scales at 6th/11th/16th, and recharges on short or long rest. Fizban versions replace one Attack action attack, scale at 5th/11th/17th, and use proficiency-bonus uses per long rest.
features.uses: varies by version: once per short/long rest or proficiency bonus per long rest

features.name: Damage Resistance
features.description: Resistance to the damage type associated with ancestry.

features.name: Gem Flight
features.description: Gem dragonborn can manifest spectral wings at 5th level as a bonus action, gaining flying speed equal to walking speed and hover for 1 minute once per long rest.
features.uses: once per long rest

features.name: Psionic Mind
features.description: Gem dragonborn can telepathically speak to a visible creature within 30 feet that understands at least one language.

features.name: Metallic Breath Weapon
features.description: Metallic dragonborn gain a second breath at 5th level that can incapacitate or push and knock prone creatures in a cone.
features.uses: once per long rest

variants.name: Player's Handbook Dragonborn
variants.description: Fixed Strength and Charisma increases, ancestry breath weapon, and ancestry resistance.

variants.name: Draconblood
variants.description: Wildemount variant replacing PHB Ability Score Increase and Damage Resistance with Intelligence/Charisma increases, darkvision, and Forceful Presence.

features.name: Forceful Presence
features.description: Advantage on one Intimidation or Persuasion check once per long rest.
features.uses: once per long rest

variants.name: Ravenite
variants.description: Wildemount variant replacing PHB Ability Score Increase and Damage Resistance with Strength/Constitution increases, darkvision, and reaction attack after taking damage.

features.name: Vengeful Assault
features.description: When damaged by a creature in range of a wielded weapon, use reaction to attack that creature once per short or long rest.
features.uses: once per short or long rest

variants.name: Chromatic Dragonborn
variants.description: Fizban variant with flexible ability scores, line breath, damage resistance, and temporary damage immunity at 5th level.

variants.name: Metallic Dragonborn
variants.description: Fizban variant with flexible ability scores, cone breath, damage resistance, and a control-oriented second breath at 5th level.

variants.name: Gem Dragonborn
variants.description: Fizban variant with flexible ability scores, cone breath, damage resistance, telepathy, and temporary flight at 5th level.

build_notes: Breath weapon and resistance damage type must be selected from ancestry rather than applied globally.
Fizban variants are stronger for builds that value flexible ability scores and proficiency-based uses.
Gem dragonborn adds a notable mobility and communication package but only after level 5.
review_reasons: Page includes multiple source versions and Unearthed Arcana sections; version choice materially changes mechanics.

name: Dwarf
summary: Dwarves are durable humanoids with poison resilience, darkvision, weapon and artisan tool proficiencies, and subrace options emphasizing toughness, armor, or warding magic.

tools: smith's tools or brewer's supplies or mason's tools

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance against poison damage.

features.name: Dwarven Combat Training
features.description: Proficiency with battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency with one of smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.

features.name: Stonecunning
features.description: For Intelligence (History) checks related to stonework origin, count as proficient and add double proficiency bonus.

variants.name: Hill Dwarf
variants.description: Adds Wisdom and increased hit point maximum each level.

features.name: Dwarven Toughness
features.description: Hit point maximum increases by 1 and by 1 again whenever gaining a level.

variants.name: Mountain Dwarf
variants.description: Adds Strength and light/medium armor proficiency.

features.name: Dwarven Armor Training
features.description: Proficiency with light and medium armor.

variants.name: Mark of Warding
variants.description: Eberron subrace with Investigation/thieves' tools bonus and warding spell access.

features.name: Wards and Seals
features.description: Cast Alarm and Mage Armor; at 3rd level also Arcane Lock. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability and material components are not required.
features.uses: once per spell per long rest

build_notes: Base dwarf is strong for poison-heavy campaigns and tool/history utility.
Hill Dwarf improves durability independent of class.
Mountain Dwarf can support armor access for classes that lack it.
Mark of Warding should be gated as an Eberron dragonmark option.
review_reasons: Page includes setting-specific and Plane Shift material; Mark of Warding changes mechanics substantially.

name: Elf
summary: Elves are dexterous humanoids with darkvision, charm resistance, trance, Perception proficiency, and many subraces that add weapons, spellcasting, mobility, stealth, teleportation, or setting-specific options.

languages: some variants add one additional language or Common plus one agreed language
condition_immunities: magic can't put PHB elves to sleep

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed; PHB wording also says magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Trance
features.description: Elves meditate for 4 hours instead of sleeping and gain the benefit of an 8-hour sleep.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: Proficiency in the Perception skill.

variants.name: Dark Elf
variants.description: Charisma increase, 120-foot darkvision, sunlight sensitivity, Drow Magic, and weapon training.

variants.name: High Elf
variants.description: Intelligence increase, wizard cantrip, weapon training, and extra language.

variants.name: Wood Elf
variants.description: Wisdom increase, weapon training, 35-foot speed, and hiding while lightly obscured by natural phenomena.

variants.name: Pallid Elf
variants.description: Wisdom increase, advantage on Investigation and Insight, plus Light, Sleep, and self-only Invisibility spells.

variants.name: Mark of Shadow
variants.description: Charisma increase, Stealth/Performance d4 bonus, Minor Illusion, Invisibility, and expanded mark spells for spellcasters.

variants.name: Astral Elf
variants.description: Flexible ability scores, cantrip choice, darkvision, charm protection, Perception, bonus-action teleportation, and trance-granted temporary proficiency.

features.name: Starlight Step
features.description: Bonus action teleport up to 30 feet to a visible unoccupied space, proficiency bonus uses per long rest.
features.uses: proficiency bonus per long rest

build_notes: Base elf is broadly useful due to Perception, charm protection, and trance.
Apply subrace mechanics only after the selected elf variant is known.
Astral Elf should be modeled separately from PHB elf because it uses flexible ability scores and different feature wording.
review_reasons: Page contains many setting-specific, Plane Shift, Spelljammer, and Unearthed Arcana variants; not all variants were expanded in this batch file.

name: Gnome
summary: Gnomes are small intelligent humanoids with darkvision and strong mental saves against magic, with forest, rock, and scribing variants adding illusion, beast communication, crafting, lore, or language magic.

features.name: Gnome Cunning
features.description: Advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves against magic.

variants.name: Forest Gnome
variants.description: Dexterity increase, Minor Illusion cantrip using Intelligence, and simple communication with Small or smaller beasts.

features.name: Natural Illusionist
features.description: Know the Minor Illusion cantrip; Intelligence is the spellcasting modifier.
features.uses: at will cantrip

variants.name: Rock Gnome
variants.description: Constitution increase, doubled proficiency bonus for History checks about magical, alchemical, or technological items, and tinker's tools crafting for small clockwork devices.

features.name: Tinker
features.description: Proficiency with tinker's tools and ability to construct Tiny clockwork devices such as a toy, fire starter, or music box.
features.uses: up to three active devices

variants.name: Mark of Scribing
variants.description: Charisma increase, d4 bonus to History or Calligrapher's Supplies checks, Message cantrip, Comprehend Languages, Magic Mouth at 3rd level, and mark spells for spellcasters.

features.name: Scribe's Insight
features.description: Know Message and cast Comprehend Languages; starting at 3rd level cast Magic Mouth. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability.
features.uses: once per relevant spell per long rest; Message at will as cantrip

build_notes: Gnome Cunning is the strongest global mechanical identity.
Forest Gnome supports illusion utility and animal communication, not full spellcasting breadth.
Rock Gnome is the best fit for crafting, tinkering, and clockwork-flavored search recommendations.
Mark of Scribing should be gated as an Eberron dragonmark option.
review_reasons: Page includes Eberron dragonmark content; only PHB and Mark of Scribing variants were normalized.

features.name: Darkvision

features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Half-Elf Versatility

variants.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

features.name: Skill Versatility
features.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

variants.name: Elf Weapon Training
variants.description: High or Wood Elf heritage option granting proficiency with longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

features.name: Elf Weapon Training
features.description: Proficiency with longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

variants.name: Cantrip
variants.description: High Elf heritage option: one wizard cantrip; Intelligence is the spellcasting ability.

features.name: Cantrip
features.description: You know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

variants.name: Fleet of Foot
variants.description: Wood Elf heritage option: walking speed increases to 35 feet.

features.name: Fleet of Foot
features.description: Your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

variants.name: Mask of the Wild
variants.description: Wood Elf heritage option: you can attempt to hide when lightly obscured by natural phenomena.

features.name: Mask of the Wild
features.description: You can attempt to hide when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

variants.name: Drow Magic
variants.description: Dark Elf heritage option: Dancing Lights cantrip, Faerie Fire at 3rd level, Darkness at 5th level; Charisma is the spellcasting ability.

features.name: Drow Magic
features.description: Dancing Lights cantrip; Faerie Fire at 3rd level; Darkness at 5th level. Leveled spells recharge after a long rest.
features.uses: Faerie Fire and Darkness each once per long rest

variants.name: Swim Speed
variants.description: Aquatic Elf heritage option: swimming speed of 30 feet.

features.name: Swim Speed
features.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

variants.name: Mark of Detection
variants.description: Eberron option replacing Ability Score Increase and Half-Elf Versatility. Wisdom +2 and one other ability +1; d4 to Investigation/Insight; detection spellcasting and expanded spell list for Spellcasting or Pact Magic classes.

features.name: Deductive Intuition
features.description: Add a d4 to Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight) checks.

features.name: Magical Detection
features.description: Cast Detect Magic and Detect Poison and Disease; at 3rd level also See Invisibility. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability; no material components.
features.uses: Each granted spell once per long rest

variants.name: Mark of Storm
variants.description: Eberron option replacing Ability Score Increase and Half-Elf Versatility. Charisma +2 and Dexterity +1; d4 to Acrobatics and navigator's tools; lightning resistance; Gust cantrip and Gust of Wind at 3rd level.

features.name: Windwright's Intuition
features.description: Add a d4 to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks or checks involving navigator's tools.

features.name: Storm's Boon
features.description: You have resistance to lightning damage.

features.name: Headwinds
features.description: You know Gust; at 3rd level you can cast Gust of Wind once per long rest. Charisma is the spellcasting ability.
features.uses: Gust of Wind once per long rest

build_notes: Core Half-Elf is highly flexible because Charisma is fixed and two other ability score increases are chosen.
Do not apply Half-Elf Versatility choices globally; each option has its own mechanical tag profile.
Dragonmark options replace core ASI and versatility traits and should be treated as campaign/setting-specific variants.
review_reasons: Page includes Eberron dragonmark variants that replace core traits.
Several traits are selectable and should not be globally applied.

name: Half-Orc
summary: A Strength and Constitution lineage with darkvision, Intimidation proficiency, a once-per-long-rest survival feature, and bonus damage on melee weapon critical hits. The Eberron Mark of Finding replaces most Player's Handbook traits.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as bright light, and in darkness as dim light; only shades of gray in darkness.

features.name: Menacing
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.description: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead.
features.uses: Once per long rest

features.name: Savage Attacks
features.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, roll one weapon damage die one additional time and add it to the extra critical hit damage.

variants.name: Mark of Finding
variants.description: Eberron option replacing all Player's Handbook traits except Age, Alignment, Size, and Speed. Wisdom +2 and Constitution +1; darkvision; d4 to Perception/Survival; Hunter's Mark and Locate Object spellcasting; Common and Goblin languages.

features.name: Hunter's Intuition
features.description: Add a d4 to Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) checks.

features.name: Finder's Magic
features.description: Cast Hunter's Mark; at 3rd level also Locate Object. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability.
features.uses: Each granted spell once per long rest

build_notes: Core Half-Orc strongly supports melee weapon builds that value critical hits and durability.
Relentless Endurance is a defensive floor, not healing; it should be tagged as death prevention rather than self healing.
Mark of Finding substantially changes the lineage profile toward Wisdom, tracking, and spell utility.
review_reasons: Page includes an Eberron dragonmark variant that replaces most core traits.

name: Halfling
summary: A Small Dexterity lineage with Lucky rerolls, fear-related saving throw support, movement through larger creatures' spaces, and multiple subraces or setting-specific options that add stealth, poison resilience, telepathy, nature magic, hospitality, or healing.

features.name: Lucky
features.description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new result.

features.name: Brave
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Nimble
features.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than yours.

variants.name: Lightfoot
variants.description: Charisma +1. Naturally Stealthy allows hiding when obscured by a creature at least one size larger.

features.name: Naturally Stealthy
features.description: You can attempt to hide even when only obscured by a creature at least one size larger than you.

variants.name: Stout
variants.description: Constitution +1. Advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage.

features.name: Stout Resilience
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage.

variants.name: Ghostwise
variants.description: Wisdom +1. Silent Speech grants 30-foot telepathic communication to one creature at a time if you share a language.

features.name: Silent Speech
features.description: You can speak telepathically to one creature within 30 feet if you share a language.

variants.name: Lotusden
variants.description: Wisdom +1. Grants Druidcraft, Entangle at 3rd level, Spike Growth at 5th level; Timberwalk hinders tracking and ignores extra movement from nonmagical plant difficult terrain.

features.name: Children of the Woods
features.description: Druidcraft cantrip; Entangle at 3rd level; Spike Growth at 5th level. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability and material components are not required.
features.uses: Entangle and Spike Growth each once per long rest

features.name: Timberwalk
features.description: Checks to track you have disadvantage, and nonmagical plant difficult terrain does not cost extra movement.

variants.name: Mark of Hospitality
variants.description: Charisma +1. Adds d4 to Persuasion, brewer's tools, or cook's utensils checks; grants Prestidigitation, Purify Food and Drink, and Unseen Servant plus expanded spell list for Spellcasting or Pact Magic classes.

features.name: Ever Hospitable
features.description: Add a d4 to Charisma (Persuasion) checks or checks involving brewer's tools or cook's utensils.

features.name: Innkeeper's Magic
features.description: Prestidigitation cantrip; cast Purify Food and Drink and Unseen Servant. Charisma is the spellcasting ability.
features.uses: Purify Food and Drink and Unseen Servant each once per long rest

variants.name: Mark of Healing
variants.description: Wisdom +1. Adds d4 to Medicine or herbalism kit checks; grants Cure Wounds and Lesser Restoration at 3rd level plus expanded healing spells for Spellcasting or Pact Magic classes.

features.name: Medical Intuition
features.description: Add a d4 to Wisdom (Medicine) checks or checks involving an herbalism kit.

features.name: Healing Touch
features.description: Cast Cure Wounds; beginning at 3rd level also Lesser Restoration. Wisdom is the spellcasting ability.
features.uses: Each granted spell once per long rest

build_notes: Core Halfling mechanics improve reliability and mobility rather than a specific combat style.
Subrace tags should be applied only when that subrace is selected.
Mark of Healing is the strongest healing-oriented Halfling option in this page.
review_reasons: Page includes Sword Coast, Wildemount, and Eberron setting-specific options.
Subrace and dragonmark traits should not be applied globally.
